title: Why Cats Can't Taste Sweetness
description:
Domestic cats carry an unexpressed Tas1r2 pseudogene, so the two-part sweet-taste receptor cannot form.

A cat's indifference to sweets is receptor biology, not pickiness or a preference for expensive food.

Sources:
- Li, X. et al. (2005). Pseudogenization of a Sweet-Receptor Gene Accounts for Cats' Indifference toward Sugar. PLoS Genetics 1(1), e3. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pgen.0010003
